title: OCW-RPL: Open Courseware for Software Engineering (Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak)
description:
A zero-dependency, no-build-step, JSON-driven micro-framework deployed as open courseware for the Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak (Software Engineering) course IMP307 at Universitas IPWIJA, Jakarta. The platform transforms declarative JavaScript objects into rendered components — hero sections, feature cards, quiz engines, certificate verifiers, and 16-module structured learning content — without any external libraries or build toolchains.

The course covers the full software engineering lifecycle in a project-driven approach using the PREP framework (Point → Reason → Example → Penegasan): RPL fundamentals and software characteristics (engineered, not manufactured; software decay), feasibility studies (PIECES framework — Performance, Information, Economics, Control, Efficiency, Services), project management (4P: People, Product, Process, Project; COCOMO, Function Point, Risk Register), SDLC models (Waterfall, Prototyping, Spiral, RAD, Agile/Scrum — comparative analysis with real industry cases), requirements engineering and SRS documentation (Functional vs Non-Functional vs Domain Requirements, elicitation techniques, Verification vs Validation), analysis modeling (DFD Level 0/1/2, Kamus Data, Transform vs Transaction Mapping), software design (architectural design with Cohesion & Coupling metrics, interface design with UI principles, data design), testing strategies (White Box: Cyclomatic Complexity V(G)=E-N+2P, Basis Path Testing; Black Box: BVA, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table), and Software Quality Assurance (SQA vs Testing distinction, FTR mechanism, McCall's Quality Factors: Correctness, Reliability, Maintainability, Usability, IEEE 730, CMMI).

The framework lineage traces from Ktupad (2019, PHP/MVC) → BayamJS (2023, JS/MVC) → DonatJS (2024–2026, JSON-driven CSR). Lighthouse audit metrics: Performance 98, Accessibility 92, Best Practices 100, SEO 90.
